findings.title: Pagination computes an extra page for exact multiples
findings.body: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is a positive multiple of limit (for example 50 users with limit 50), this returns 2 instead of 1. As a result the first page is not treated as the last page, Next sets offset to user_count, and the UI shows an empty second page. Use Math.ceil(user_count / limit).

findings.title: Member list iterates controller property `members` instead of the group's members
findings.body: The group-members route now sets the controller model to the Group object and calls model.findMembers(), which populates model.members. This template iterates `members` directly. The route does not set a controller property named `members`, so with the generated route controller the list will be empty. Iterate `model.members` or expose `members` on the controller.

findings.title: Usernames are split on comma but not stripped
findings.body: The client sends a comma-separated string. If it contains spaces, e.g. 'alice, bob', split(',') yields ' bob' and User.find_by_username(' bob') returns nil. The request then succeeds but silently skips valid users. Strip each username after splitting before lookup.

findings.title: Group create ignores alias_level from the client
findings.body: The client Group#asJSON sends alias_level and the admin form always displays the alias level combo for new groups, but create only sets name and visible. A new group saved with a non-default alias level is persisted with the default alias_level 0; the client model is only updated with the id from the response, so the UI continues showing the unsaved selection. Assign group.alias_level from params if present.

findings.title: Automatic-group removal test uses PUT instead of the DELETE route
findings.body: The routes map remove_member to DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members, but this spec calls xhr :put, :remove_member. Controller specs bypass the router and the action does not check request method, so the test does not verify the actual HTTP method or catch a misrouted DELETE. Use xhr :delete, :remove_member.

findings.title: No spec for the paginated public members JSON contract
findings.body: GroupsController#members changed from rendering a serialized member array to returning a custom {members, meta} object with limit, offset, and meta.total for all groups. This is a public API contract change, but no controller spec in the PR covers the JSON shape, default limit, offset, total, or authorization/visibility behavior.
